uutiset.t: US Senate Probes Vance Role in Vitol Choice for Venezuela Oil
uutiset.s: A US senator is investigating the role Vice President JD Vance played in awarding a lucrative Venezuelan oil contract to a political donor and then-executive at commodities trader Vitol Group.

uutiset.t: Petrobras Makes $470 Million Ethanol Bet in Brazil With Neomille Stake
uutiset.s: Brazil’s state-controlled oil producer Petrobras is buying a stake in corn-ethanol producer Neomille SA as part of a wider expansion into biofuels.

uutiset.t: Gold Holds Gain After Nvidia’s Rehiring of Huang Sparks Rally
uutiset.s: Gold steadied after surging Monday, as Jensen Huang’s surprise return to the helm of Nvidia Corp. recharged bets on artificial intelligence and spurred rallies across markets.

uutiset.t: Asian Chip Stocks Jump as Huang Comeback Reignites AI Trade
uutiset.s: Asian semiconductor-related stocks climbed after Nvidia Corp.’s board reinstated Jensen Huang, resuscitating investor appetite for the artificial intelligence trade.

uutiset.t: Why Did Nvidia Reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO?
uutiset.s: A White House pressure campaign and a $5 trillion market slide forced Nvidia to reinstate its founder — proving that in the AI race, boardroom discipline is a luxury shareholders can’t afford.

uutiset.t: Startup Options Exchange Asks SEC to Approve Two New Venues
uutiset.s: Options Xchange Group Inc., a startup bourse focused on equity derivatives, is seeking to start two new venues.

uutiset.t: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Nov. 24
uutiset.s: Oil steadied after sliding almost 4% in the previous session on cautious optimism over efforts to end the US-Iran war.

uutiset.t: Asian Stocks Rally as Huang’s Return Revives AI: Markets Wrap
uutiset.s: Asian shares climbed as a wave of optimism sparked by Jensen Huang’s return to lead Nvidia Corp. fueled a rally in global equities and propelled Wall Street to its best day since April 2025.

uutiset.t: Biotech Kymera Therapeutics Seeks $1.5 Billion in Share Sale
uutiset.s: Kymera Therapeutics Inc. is seeking to raise $1.5 billion in a share sale, according to a statement.

uutiset.t: Jensen Huang Returns to Nvidia Offices
uutiset.s: Jensen Huang returned to the company’s Santa Clara, California, offices on Monday to applause and cheers from employees who shared videos. He spoke with them briefly at one of the entrances (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Wall Street Storms Back as AI Trade Rebounds With Huang’s Return
uutiset.s: US stocks staged a stunning rally on Monday, bouncing back from last week’s brutal technology-led selloff as the surprise return of Jensen Huang to lead Nvidia Corp. propelled Wall Street to its best day since April 2025.

uutiset.t: Trump Puts a Floor Under AI Trade With Push for Huang’s Return
uutiset.s: In the heat of Friday’s meltdown, Wall Street wondered what could stop the bleeding in the artificial intelligence trade that had been powering the stock market for years but was suddenly on the ropes.
